searchText: "consensus client" is something of a misnomer in that it comprises of two "roles" typically, in the general architecture: the beacon node and the validator client - the beacon api is the api that the beacon node exposes (mainly to the validator client) so it should reasonably be called a beacon API Are you aware of anybody mining Sepolia? excerpts.author: arnetheduck
excerpts.content: "consensus client" is something of a misnomer in that it comprises of two "roles" typically, in the general architecture: the beacon node and the validator client - the beacon api is the api that the beacon node exposes (mainly to the validator client) so it should reasonably be called a beacon API
